Play Basketball Arena Online - Free 3D Basketball Game

Basketball Arena is a free 3D arcade basketball shooting game that runs directly in your web browser - no download, no install, no sign-up required. Drag the ball to set your shot, release to shoot, and use the orbit camera to line up the perfect angle. Score baskets to build combos, trigger Fire Mode for a 5x score multiplier, and chase the global leaderboard.

Game Modes

Challenge yourself across 7 game modes: Arcade (score maximum points in 60 seconds), Time Attack (every basket adds 5 seconds), Moving Hoop, Trick Shot (only swishes and banks count), Challenge (complete 10 objectives), Hard Mode (small ring, moving hoop, no aiming guide), and Practice (free shooting with no timer).

Features & Tips

Realistic physics powered by Cannon.js with 3D graphics from Three.js. Unlock basketball skins, customise sound effects, background music and bloom effects. Aim for the center of the rim for a PERFECT swish, bank shots off the backboard, and sink long-range shots to build your best streak.
